author: NIN Creative Studio
title: Hiring Illustrator Artists – All Levels
content: 🎨 NIN Creative Studio is Hiring! Are you passionate about Illustration and ready to turn creative ideas into compelling artwork? NIN Creative Studio is looking for Illustrator Artists – All Levels to join us on a variety of creative projects, from Characters and Creatures to Environments, Fantasy, and Game Art. Check out the full Job Description here: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4475930253/ Send your CV + Portfolio via LinkedIn or email us at nincreativestudio@gmail.com Subject: Application – Illustrator Artist – [Your Name]

author: Baltic Analog Lab
title: Looking for illustrator for new merch
content: We’re looking for a freelance graphic designer (preferably based in Latvia) for occasional collaborations, as well as an illustrator (national or international) to create fun artwork for our new merch! 🦄 Send us a DM with your Instagram account or website. And if you know someone whose work you love, share your recommendations with us! ✨ Contact: DM on Instagram.

author: MEOWTAKU
title: Calling Malaysian artists and illustrators for collaboration
content: 🎨✨ CALLING ALL MALAYSIAN ARTISTS & ILLUSTRATORS! MEOWTAKU is looking for talented local creatives to join our growing artist community at SOGO Kuala Lumpur! 💌 INTERESTED IN JOINING US? Simply DM us "ARTIST" on Instagram and share your portfolio or product catalogue. We'll be happy to discuss potential collaboration opportunities with you!

author: Vineeth Vasudevan
title: Looking for Freelance Poster Designers
content: Looking for Freelance Poster Designers 🎨 I’m expanding my creative team and looking for passionate freelance designers to work with me on movie posters and title designs. Send your portfolio by DM. Beginners with great potential are welcome too. Let’s create something amazing together! Contact: DM on Instagram.
